issues.description: Constructor 'Lecture(...)': The problem statement (and UML) requires a constructor that initializes five attributes: lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, and numberOfTutors. The template implementation declares a constructor with only three parameters: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents). The solution repository implements the expected five-parameter constructor: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). This mismatch between the template and the problem/solution will confuse students about the expected signature and which fields must be initialized and may lead to compilation or test failures when students follow the UML or the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the template's Lecture class to declare a constructor with five parameters in the UML-specified order: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Ensure the constructor assigns each parameter to the corresponding private field (this.lectureName = lectureName; etc.). This brings the template in line with the problem statement and the solution while preserving the intended exercise structure.
